description_expanded: OverviewCoastal Charm in Blue Mountain Beach | Outdoor Oasis + Bikes + Golf Cart Option - 'Driftwood Dreams'The Space QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Spacious Open Floor Plan – Bright, airy, & perfect for gatherings Private Backyard with State Park Views – Serene forest setting for extra privacy Fully Stocked Kitchen – Includes modern appliances, granite countertops & beverage fridge 6-Seat Dining Table – Plenty of space for family meals & entertaining 4-Seater Golf Cart Rental Option – Golf cart available to rent at a discounted price!* 4 Adult Bikes Included – Explore 30A’s scenic trails & beach towns Minutes from the Public Beach – Easy access to Blue Mountain Beach’s sugar-white sands Relax & Recharge in Blue Mountain Beach 4 Bedrooms | 4 Bathrooms | Sleeps 7 | Outdoor Lounge + Bikes + Golf Cart Option Welcome to your Blue Mountain Beach escape—where laid-back luxury, coastal charm, and outdoor living come together for the perfect 30A vacation. Step inside to a bright, open-concept main floor designed for comfort and connection. Natural light fills the living room, where cozy seating invites you to kick back and relax after a day in the sun. The adjacent dining space flows seamlessly into a fully equipped kitchen featuring granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a breakfast bar. With four bedrooms and four full bathrooms, this home comfortably sleeps 7 and offers both privacy and flexibility for families or small groups. The first floor features one bedroom with a queen sized bed and private en suite bath. Upstairs you will find the Master bedroom with King sized bed and en suite bath. Also on second floor, you will find one one bedroom with a queen sized bed with private bathroom and an additional bedroom that doubles as a Pilates studio with a twin sized bed and private en suite bath. But the real star of this home is the outdoor living space. The large patio is a private retreat made for long, lazy afternoons and evenings under the stars. Fire up the Blackstone grill for a casual cookout, lounge in the shade with a drink in hand, or catch the game or a movie on the outdoor TV—all in a comfortable, coastal setting designed for memory-making. When you're ready to explore, hop on one of the four included adult bikes and cruise to nearby restaurants, shops, and the public beach access just minutes away. Prefer to ride in style? A golf cart rental is available to make getting around even easier. Located in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach, you're just a short walk or ride from favorites like Cowgirl Kitchen, Blue Mountain Bakery, Redfish Taco, and Blue Mountain Creamery. Spend the day at the beach, ride the nearby trails, or explore the scenic dune lakes that make this area so unique. Golf Carts: IMPORTANT INFORMATION BELOW: -To operate the golf cart, guests must have a valid drivers license and be at least 21 years old. -Please be aware of the golf cart rules and regulations -A copy of the golf carts terms and conditions will be emailed upon reservation and will require signatures **Golf cart is not guaranteed. PLEASE NOTE - ** FL law states that any underage and/or unlicensed driver of a street legal golf cart is considered a criminal offense and a $500 fine including a possible 60 days in jail. It’s a very serious offense for underage/unlicensed driving of a LSV in the State of FL.** SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (7): First Floor Master - Queen sized bed, private en suite bathroom Second Floor Bedroom - King sized bed, private en suite bathroom Second Floor Bedroom- Queen sized bed, private en suite bathroom Second Floor Bedroom/Pilates Studio - Twin sized bed, private en suite bathroom AREA ATTRACTIONS: Lakeside is a residential neighborhood at Blue Mountain Beach. A short walk/bike ride away is the community pool and multiple Blue Mountain Beach access points. Blue Mountain Beach is the perfect area for enjoying breathtaking Gulf views, exploring scenic biking trails, and discovering the unique coastal dune lakes. Nature lovers can venture to Grayton Beach State Park for hiking, paddleboarding, and a visit to the one-of-a-kind Underwater Museum of Art. The areas’ vibrant dining scene features Cowgirl Kitchen and Red Fish Taco, as well as homemade ice cream from Blue Mountain Beach Creamery. For shopping and essentials, For the Health of It offers organic groceries and wellness products making this charming stretch of 30A a well-rounded destination.Show less
